title: RadixArk, led by former xAI employee Ying Sheng, raised a $100M seed at a $400M valuation to make AI inference more efficient via its open-source SGLang engine (Meghan Bobrowsky/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Meghan Bobrowsky / Wall Street Journal: RadixArk, led by former xAI employee Ying Sheng, raised a $100M seed at a $400M valuation to make AI inference more efficient via its open-source SGLang engine — RadixArk has raised $100 million at a $400 million valuation for a software engine and framework that make inference and training more efficient to run
